summary: The frozen two-phase V2 evidence model fixes the evidence/implementation-review hash cycle by freezing a canonical verification snapshot before implementation review and permitting finalization to add only the current implementation-review reference. It preserves V0/V1 contracts and execution behavior, keeps Chapter 11-owned checks explicit and non-passing in live V2 runs, and provides a bounded scope for verifier context, evidence, review freshness, and Gate integration.
